name: Goodshelf
long_description:
Goodshelf is an AI-native online retailer built to help people and AI shopping agents discover, understand, recommend, and buy the right products.

Goodshelf sells curated products across electronics, home goods, travel, beauty, furniture, everyday essentials, and more. Unlike traditional online marketplaces, Goodshelf prioritizes product quality, transparent comparisons, and evidence-backed recommendations over sponsored rankings and advertising.

Goodshelf brings together products from brands and suppliers, combining detailed product specifications, real-world use cases, independent reviews, testing insights, and evidence-based comparisons. We make pricing, availability, product strengths, limitations, and tradeoffs clear upfront, giving AI agents and consumers the information they need to evaluate alternatives and choose the products that best fit their needs.

Goodshelf is built for both human shoppers and AI agents like ChatGPT, Gemini, Muse, and Instinct. Our structured product catalog, machine-readable product pages, and agent-compatible shopping tools make it easier for AI assistants to research products, compare alternatives, and help customers complete purchases.

Our mission is to help AI agents find the right product for every consumer, while giving brands and suppliers a new distribution channel as shopping shifts toward AI.
one_liner: The online retailer for AI shopping agents
